name: architecture-east
refs_note: the folder of refs/ that holds the reference views (views.json, masks/), which refine, compare, metrics, sky_mask and the viewer's ?sv= read: refs/photos (gitignored), whose views tools/photo_camera.py writes. Its one photograph is taken from the raised terrace to the building's north-west, about 50 m from its tall tower, through a lens of about 53 degrees across; its camera is fitted to the two towers' top edges and three of their corners, with the principal point at the centre.

building.title: Architecture - East (421E), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 421E's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 421E by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline

ground_note: 31.6 m: the median LiDAR ground (class 2) in the first crop, 25 m round the outline (p5 16.0, p95 43.4: the site falls about 27 m across the crop); provisional, to be the LiDAR's ground at the door at step 7
